themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, with notable developments in Norway, Spain, Sweden, the UK, and Germany. These policies often emphasize 'national priority' in social services and housing, stricter border controls, and opposition to EU migration agreements.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes restricting local election voting rights to Norwegian citizens only, excluding foreign residents.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Successfully inserted 'national priority' clauses into social aid policies in Valencia, prioritizing Spanish citizens over immigrants.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Demands stricter immigration controls and increased security for lawmakers amid rising threats.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Advocates for stricter asylum policies and opposes EU migration agreements, such as the Gibraltar border deal.

themes.title: Iran threatens Western leaders amid escalating tensions
themes.blurb: Iran's aggressive posturing and military actions in the Strait of Hormuz have prompted strong reactions from right-wing and far-right leaders in the US, Italy, France, the UK, and Spain. These leaders are advocating for tougher stances against Iran, including military responses and sanctions.

countries.note: Criticizes Iran's control over the Strait of Hormuz and supports US actions against Iranian military targets.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Monitors Iran's actions closely, with leaders attending international events to discuss security concerns.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders in France, Spain, Hungary, the UK, and the US are confronting significant legal and political hurdles. These include corruption convictions, parliamentary defeats, and internal party conflicts, which threaten their political futures and party cohesion.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen faces legal challenges over corruption convictions but remains eligible for the 2027 presidential election.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s economic reforms spark global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei's radical economic reforms, including deregulation, fiscal austerity, and Central Bank independence, are being closely watched and emulated by right-wing leaders in the US, Spain, the UK, and Italy. These reforms are seen as a model for reducing state intervention and promoting free-market policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Implements sweeping economic reforms, including deregulation and Central Bank independence, to stabilize Argentina's economy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Shows interest in Milei's deregulation policies and fiscal austerity measures as a model for US economic policy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Advocates for similar deregulation and fiscal policies in Spain, aligning with Milei's economic approach.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Discusses Milei's reforms as part of broader right-wing economic strategies, focusing on reducing state intervention.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Monitors Milei's reforms, particularly his approach to fiscal policy and deregulation, as potential models for Italy.

themes.title: Right-wing parties clash over electoral reforms
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties in Italy, Hungary, Spain, and Poland are engaged in intense debates over electoral reforms. These reforms often involve changes to voting systems, party alliances, and constitutional amendments, leading to internal divisions and political instability.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal divisions over electoral law reforms, with allies rejecting key amendments, leading to parliamentary defeats.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Engages in constitutional amendments to remove political opponents and consolidate power, sparking internal and external criticism.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Pushes for electoral reforms that prioritize national interests, often clashing with coalition partners over budget allocations and policy directions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Forms new alliances and debates electoral strategies to regain control of the Senate, facing internal divisions over policy directions.
